Chief"With an inside collaborator to guide us, matters would differ. But we have not arranged that yet."

Muramasa"..."

en.html:
As expected, nobody agreed. Only the silent Ichijou Ayane, and those not present at all, failed to object.

Kanae Ootori and her chamberlain had left the temple. Apparently they had flown <ruby>to foreign lands<rt>abroad</rt></ruby> for some clandestine work. Something involving UN headquarters; I had not understood it well.

私には良くわからない。

en.html:
Chachamaru Ashikaga had said Hikaru Minato had little life left. No lie there: examining her with an armor’s eyes led to the same conclusion.

Then Kageaki, who now wanted to preserve her life, and Chachamaru, who wanted to use Silver Star to fulfill some desire, had little time either.

I could not imagine a leisurely plan. Whatever they intended, they would settle it shortly.

And once it was settled, surely... <ruby>nothing could be done<rt>・・・・・・・・</rt></ruby> anymore.

ja.html:
湊斗光の寿命は残り僅かだと、足利茶々丸は言って
いた。
　あの言葉に嘘はない――劒冑の眼で診ても同じ結論
を出せた。

　なら……
　湊斗光を生かしたい今の景明と、銀星号を利用して
何かの望みを遂げたい茶々丸にとっても、時間は残り
少ないということになる。

　悠長な計画を立てているとは思えない。
　何をするつもりでいるにしろ、短時日のうちに決着
をつける気だろう。

　そして、その決着がついてしまったなら。
　きっと――もう何もかも、<ruby>どうにもならない<rt>・・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>。

en.html:
Chief"Muramasa, wait."
Muramasa"..."
Chief"Your Highness... may we?"
舞殿宮"Yes. Somehow this has decided it for me."
黒瀬"Indeed."
Muramasa"...?"
Chief"Muramasa, if you go, cooperate with us. There is a better chance that way."
Muramasa"—Eh?"
Muramasa"No, but..."
Chief"Do not misunderstand. We have circumstances of our own."
舞殿宮"Truth is, we cannot sit comfortably waiting either. Driven to a gamble, that is where we stand."
黒瀬"Our interference failed. Kuniuji Ashikaga’s appointment is confirmed. Even the ceremony’s date and time are fixed."
Chief"The ceremony means Rokuhara’s restoration; that means the beginning of the decisive battle with the occupation forces. The worst development we wished to prevent is approaching."
舞殿宮"Kanae is working at the UN, but whether she can make it in time, nobody knows. We had to act here also."
Chief"Something that forces the ceremony’s cancellation or postponement. ...That is our situation, Muramasa."
Muramasa"..."

en.html:
黒瀬"I also have a private reason. My sister-in-law is held in Fudaraku Castle."
黒瀬"I have planned her rescue repeatedly, without success. This time I wish to bring her out."
舞殿宮"Sakurako... yes..."
Chief"As for the precise plan—"
Ichijou"No point dressing it up. However much you knead the plan, reckless remains reckless."
Ichijou"Sneak as far as we can. Once discovered, make havoc. Smash the place until holding a ceremony becomes impossible."
Ichijou"That is victory."
舞殿宮"..."
Chief"..."
Chief"Quite."
舞殿宮"Quite!?"
Chief"We lack the information for a proper operational plan. Further thought alone would waste time."
黒瀬"Indeed, indeed. I support Ichijou."
舞殿宮"...You lot are very openly the athletics department."
Chief"Then let us summarize. Ayane, Kuronose and Muramasa infiltrate Fudaraku."
Chief"Inside, Ayane disrupts the castle. Kuronose rescues Princess Sakurako. Muramasa finds Kageaki. I shall arrange the retreat."
Chief"Agreed?"
Ichijou"Yes."
黒瀬"Indeed."
Muramasa"...Yes."
